title: Tint Shaders
description: Heavily optimized shaders for minecraft with 5 different modes. This was an experiment to see if A.I could make minecraft shaders in one prompt. These are the results, and its amazing
body: AI shaders generated in 1 prompt (omg). I built this for 1.21.10 but also works for 1.21+. This shader adds simple shadows and is optimized for potato PCs. It containts 5 different modes from minimal, low, medium, high, and cinema. I hope you enjoy this shader.
